summary: Hello Neighbor entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Hello Neighbor

primary.why: The PC release is the cleanest capture/settings route for the full 2017 stealth-horror game and preserves the alpha-to-release lineage through Steam/community documentation. Console and mobile ports are access routes rather than content upgrades.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC version. Record build, graphics settings, input device, act/progression state, and whether any alpha/beta builds or current-generation console ports were compared.

secondary.why: Hello Neighbor's pre-release builds are important but should not be merged into the full release route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether using full release, alpha/beta build, or later console port.
